contests.title: 6a.AGRUPACION
contests.notes: P.14 column headers were typed wrongly (F.Socialista ... Total general, struck through) and corrected by hand to A.Nacional ... E.Radical; the p.15 TOTAL GENERAL 270.671 is handwritten over a smudged typed figure.

contests.title: PRIMER DISTRITO (TOTAL 7a. AGRUPACION)
contests.notes: Santiago, Primer Distrito; the total row is labelled 'TOTAL 7a. AGRUPACION'. Elected list p.207 heads it '7a. Agrupación Departamental : Primer Distrito'.

contests.title: SEGUNDO DISTRITO (TOTAL 7a. AGRUPACION)
contests.notes: Santiago, Segundo Distrito (includes Talagante); total row labelled 'TOTAL 7a. AGRUPACION'. H.Social Dem. de Chile column printed with '-' (no list).

contests.title: TERCER DISTRITO
contests.notes: Santiago, Tercer Distrito (Pedro Aguirre Cerda, Puente Alto). The p.200 summary prints different figures for this district (Nacional 88.271, Comunista 57.714, D.Nacional 3.738, USP 1.652, Radical 20.632, Socialista 53.708, DC 93.764, nulos 12.046, blancos 4.017, total 335.542); the escrutinio table (used here) sums exactly, and the national totals on p.199 agree with the escrutinio table, not with p.200. invalid/blank left null because p.200's split belongs to the other count.

contests.title: OCTAVA AGRUPACION
contests.notes: Octava Agrupación (Melipilla, San Antonio, San Bernardo, Maipo), pages 22-25: parties A-F on p.23, G-I and accounting on p.25. p.200 labels this row '8a. Santiago 4° Distrit.'

contests.title: DECIMOPRIMERA AGRUPACION
contests.notes: Radical 5.581 as printed in the escrutinio table (departments 4.527 + 1.054); the p.200 summary appears to print 5.681 but its column total implies 5.581.

contests.title: DECIMOQUINTA AGRUPACION
contests.notes: Decimoquinta = San Carlos e Itata (elected list p.208 agrees). The p.200 summary names row 15a 'Chillán, Bulnes y Yungay' and 16a 'San Carlos e Itata', but its figures match these tables with the names swapped.

contests.title: DECIMOSEXTA AGRUPACION
contests.notes: Decimosexta = Chillán, Bulnes y Yungay. p.200 blancos digit is ambiguous (329 or 829); 829 is the reading consistent with nulos 1.253 + blancos = 2.082 printed here and with p.200's column total.

contests.title: DECIMOSEPTIMA AGRUPACION
contests.notes: Table spans pp.42-45: parties A-E total on p.43, F-H and accounting on p.45.

contests.title: VIGESIMOPRIMERA AGRUPACION
contests.notes: Table spans pp.52-55: parties A-E total on p.53, G-H and accounting on p.55. Socialista column printed with '-'.

notes: Grouping totals are the T (total) column of the TOTAL AGRUPACION row of the 'Escrutinio general definitivo practicado por el Tribunal Calificador' tables (left page: first parties; right page: remaining parties, NULOS Y BLANCOS, TOTAL GENERAL). Nulos y blancos are printed only combined there; invalid (nulos) and blank (blancos) are from the summary table on p.200. Elected deputies from pp.206-210 (no candidate votes are printed). The 7th agrupación (Santiago) is elected in three districts, transcribed as contests 7-9; contests are numbered 1-29 sequentially, so from contest 10 on the number is the printed ordinal + 2 (contest 10 = Octava ... contest 29 = Vigesimoséptima); titles carry the printed ordinal. Lists are labelled with the printed party letters A-I; party names as printed on p.199. Lists printed with '-' in a grouping are omitted. registered not printed per grouping (national inscritos 3.244.892 on p.199); valid not printed (equals cast - null_blank). Left out: commune/department rows (pp.2-67), the candidate-by-commune tables by province (pp.68-190, department-level preferences, no grouping totals), p.191 per-grouping figures (unlabelled, apparently an electoral quotient/lowest elected figure), and party summaries pp.192-198, 201-205, 211. National party totals (p.199) equal the sum of the escrutinio tables; the p.200 summary differs only in Santiago Tercer Distrito (see contest 9).
